title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 19 JULY 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 18 July 2026 Several spells of showers will occur in Sabaragamuwa province and in Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. A few showers may occur in Western and North-western provinces and in Galle and Matara districts. Mainly dry weather will prevail over the other areas of the island. Strong winds about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Northern, North-central and North-western provinces and in Matale, Monaragala, Hambantota and Trincomalee districts.
